summary: Iteration 12: Verified NEW Overdue Digest feature. Backend: 11/11 tests passing. Frontend: All UI elements working correctly - widget displays, expands, shows customer summary and invoice details table with color-coded days badges.

issues: React hydration warning about span inside option element in FY selector - cosmetic only
WebSocket connection to sync-status fails on initial load - reconnects automatically
GET /api/customers/followups/reminders returns 405 - known issue from iteration 11

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/dashboard/overdue-digest returns success with all required fields
Backend: Response contains total_overdue_amount, total_overdue_invoices, customer_summary, overdue_invoices arrays
Backend: Overdue threshold is correctly set to 55 days (threshold_days=55)
Backend: Overdue invoice has correct fields (voucher_id, party_name, voucher_date, invoice_amount, paid_amount, overdue_amount, days_overdue)
Backend: Customer summary has correct fields (customer_name, phone, total_overdue, invoice_count, oldest_days)
Backend: All overdue invoices have days_overdue > 55 threshold
Backend: Total overdue amount matches sum of individual invoice overdue amounts
Backend: POST /api/agent/sync with sales data triggers overdue digest recomputation
Backend: Overdue amount calculation correct (overdue_amount = invoice_amount - paid_amount)
Frontend: Login with admin/admin123 works, Dashboard loads
Frontend: Overdue Payments widget displays with red border (border-red-200)
Frontend: Total overdue amount displayed in red (Rs.6,82,000 with text-red-600)
Frontend: Click widget header expands to show details
Frontend: Customer-wise Overdue section visible with 5 customers
Frontend: Invoice Details table shows all 7 columns (Invoice, Customer, Date, Amount, Paid, Overdue, Days)
Frontend: 6 invoice rows displayed in table
Frontend: Days badge is color-coded (orange for >90 days, amber for 55-90 days)
critical_code_review_comments: compute_overdue_digest() function correctly calculates overdue invoices >55 days from invoice date
FIFO distribution logic properly handles receipt payments when no bill-level allocations exist
Overdue digest is cached in MongoDB overdue_digest collection for fast dashboard reads
Digest is automatically recomputed after every sync (sales, receipts, customers)
Frontend widget is expandable/collapsible with proper state management
seed_data_creation: Used existing sales vouchers: 6 invoices from Jan 2026 (SALE001-SALE006) totaling Rs.682,000, all >55 days old and unpaid. Customers: Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd (Rs.310,000), Corporate Hub Ltd (Rs.180,000), Office Mart (Rs.102,000), Smart Enterprises (Rs.66,000), Global Systems Inc (Rs.24,000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 verified the NEW Overdue Digest feature. Key findings: (1) GET /api/dashboard/overdue-digest returns overdue invoices >55 days with customer summary, (2) ?recompute=true forces fresh calculation, (3) Sync endpoint triggers automatic recomputation, (4) Frontend widget shows expandable overdue summary with customer breakdown and invoice table, (5) Days badges are color-coded (red >120, orange >90, amber otherwise). Minor known issues: WebSocket reconnection on load, /api/customers/followups/reminders returns 405.
